name: @brandbastion-mktg/platform-ui
description: The shared top bar every application in the suite carries, and the one list of which tools exist: one stylesheet, one data file, no dependencies, no build step.
//exports: Only the stylesheet and the suite list are reachable, on purpose: the closed list in the README says what may live here, and a package that can be reached into is a package that grows. An application resolves the real path with createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve('@brandbastion-mktg/platform-ui/header.css') and serves it from there, so there is never a second copy of it on disk; tools.mjs is imported normally.
